units.source_text: 父亲在世时收集的古玩字画，已经被叔叔倒腾得差不多了。

en.t: The antiques, calligraphy, and paintings my father had collected while he was alive had already been almost completely sold off by my uncle.

units.source_text: 不过，多少还留下了一点儿，我离开故乡时，全寄存在中学时代的朋友那儿了。

en.t: Still, a few things were left, and when I left my hometown, I entrusted them all to a friend from my middle school days.

units.source_text: 我从里面选了四五幅喜欢的，不用挂轴套盒，直接塞在行李箱的最下面，

en.t: From among them I chose four or five pieces I liked, left them without scroll fittings or cases, and simply packed them at the very bottom of my trunk,

units.source_text: 刚一搬来，我就打算把它们拿出来，挂在壁龛里欣赏。

en.t: and as soon as I moved in, I meant to take them out, hang them in the alcove, and enjoy looking at them.

units.source_text: 可是，一看见这把琴和插花，顿时兴致尽失。

en.t: But the moment I saw the koto and the flower arrangement, my enthusiasm vanished at once.

units.source_text: 后来我才知道，这花是小姐特意为招待我而插的，只好心中苦笑。

en.t: Only later did I learn that the young lady had arranged the flowers specially to welcome me, and I could only smile wryly to myself.

units.source_text: 不过，那把琴是以前就放在这里的，大概是因为没有地方放，只好靠在这里吧。

en.t: The koto, however, had been there from before; probably there was nowhere else to put it, so it had simply been left leaning there.

units.source_text: 听我这么一说，想必你的脑子里会掠过一个年轻女子的身影吧。

en.t: Hearing me say this, I imagine the figure of a young woman will pass through your mind.

units.source_text: 其实我也如此，还没搬进来的时候，就已经有了这样的好奇心。

en.t: In fact, I was the same; even before I moved in, that kind of curiosity had already begun to stir in me.

units.source_text: 不知是这种邪念影响了我的坦然态度，还是我不善交际，

en.t: I do not know whether such improper thoughts affected my natural composure, or whether I was simply poor at dealing with people,

units.source_text: 反正我初次见到这位小姐时，只是手足无措地问了个好。

en.t: but at any rate, when I first met the young lady, I could only greet her in an awkward, flustered way.

units.source_text: 幸而，小姐也是一样的羞涩满面。

en.t: Fortunately, the young lady was just as shy and flushed as I was.
